name: Shapla Grand Hotel
description: A fictional upscale independent hotel combining contemporary Bangladeshi design with calm, attentive service in central Dhaka.

information.location: Shapla Grand is in the fictional Shapla Avenue district of Gulshan, Dhaka, about twenty minutes from Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in light traffic.
information.check_in: Check-in begins at 3:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability and cannot be guaranteed in advance.
information.check_out: Check-out is by noon. Late check-out is subject to availability and may carry an additional charge.
information.parking: Complimentary secure on-site parking is available for registered guests, subject to space.
information.wifi: Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is available in guest rooms and public areas.
information.breakfast: A buffet breakfast is served from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM. It is included with suites and available for other rooms at 1,800 taka per adult and 900 taka per child.
information.restaurant: The Lotus Table serves Bangladeshi and international dishes daily from 6:30 AM until 11:00 PM. In-room dining is available around the clock with a limited overnight menu.
information.airport_pickup: Private airport pickup can be arranged with at least six hours' notice. The fictional one-way rate is 3,200 taka for a sedan or 4,800 taka for a people carrier.
information.pool: The temperature-controlled rooftop pool is open daily from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Children must be supervised by an adult.
information.gym: The fitness studio is open twenty-four hours for registered guests and includes cardio equipment, free weights, and a stretching area.
information.smoking: All guest rooms and indoor public areas are non-smoking. A designated outdoor smoking area is available on the terrace.
information.children: Children are welcome. One child under six may share existing bedding at no additional room charge. Cots are complimentary subject to availability.
information.pets: Only trained service animals are permitted. Other pets cannot be accommodated in this prototype hotel.
information.cancellation: Reservations may be cancelled without charge until 6:00 PM, two calendar days before arrival. Later cancellations and no-shows are charged one night's room rate. Flexible exceptions require a manager.
information.payment: The hotel accepts cash in Bangladeshi taka and major Visa, Mastercard, and American Express cards. This voice prototype does not collect or process payment details.
information.accessibility: Step-free public access and a limited number of accessible rooms are available. Specific accessibility requirements should be confirmed with the front desk.
information.room_assignment: Specific physical room numbers cannot be guaranteed before check-in. The hotel can record location and view preferences for the front desk.
information.visitors: Visitors must register at reception with valid identification and follow hotel security procedures. Overnight occupancy may not exceed the booked room capacity.

faqs.question: Can the hotel store luggage?
faqs.answer: Complimentary luggage storage is available for registered guests before check-in and after check-out on the same day.

faqs.question: Is a government-issued ID required?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every adult guest must present valid government-issued photo identification at check-in.

faqs.question: Does the hotel exchange currency?
faqs.answer: The front desk can direct guests to nearby licensed exchange services but does not exchange currency on site.

faqs.question: Can rooms be decorated for celebrations?
faqs.answer: Simple celebration arrangements may be requested at least forty-eight hours ahead. Pricing and availability require confirmation from the front desk.
